spec.claim_summary: Buying bitcoin only when price is more than 5% below the most recent high underperforms buying $1 every day.
spec.untestable_reason: DCA ladder with daily $1 sizing cannot be expressed as a single-position rule and is the heart of the claim.
assumptions: NOT EXPRESSIBLE: daily $1 DCA ladder with averaging, position sizing, and cumulative spend/value comparison left out; single-position engine cannot replicate it.
The 5% dip filter is the heart of Rule 2 but without the DCA sizing there is no mechanical single-position equivalent.
Most recent high has no defined lookback (all-time high vs trailing high).

audit_majors: testable: Mechanical core is testable as single-position long BTC 1d entry when price is >5% below most recent high; daily $1 DCA sizing/compounding/position-size cannot justify testable=false per audit scope.
